summary: Seattle, engineer, educated in Idaho, strong interest in rail infrastructure and transportation policy, advocates for democracy and civic engagement, critical of government and corporate accountability, supports basic income experiments, interested in automotive engineering and maintenance, has experience with BMW and Toyota vehicles, values hands-on mechanical skills, engaged in discussions about education reform and social equity, identifies as a supporter of the ACLU but critical of the NRA, expresses concern about the implications of automation on employment, has a nuanced view on political issues related to gun rights.
